verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows account-level recruitment pipeline stages exposed through the /stages endpoint and a candidate-rating endpoint. Neither documents a per-role interview plan with question banks or per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused. Pipeline stages are an adjacent feature, not the structured interview-plan capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused

citations.quote: Calling the /stages endpoint will return a collection of the recruitment pipeline stages as defined in recruiting preferences page
